long_biography.plain_text:
After studying in Switzerland and the United Kingdom, Sheikh Mohammed Youssef El Khereiji earned an MBA in marketing and finance. He worked as a consultant and financial adviser for Prudential Bache and BNP Paribas in Geneva before taking finance and board roles within the family business network.

El Khereiji's hospitality platform follows a long-horizon investment method: buy properties that can be held through strong and weak markets, then use specialist operators and partnerships to add value. Global Hotels & Resorts has applied that approach to hotel and real-estate investments in Europe and Saudi Arabia. Its current projects include adapting two French Riviera hotels for IHG's Vignette Collection.
